Lemma
[Distance-like function with first and second derivative control, II] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0170 1. ch12:12.5\group Barrier Functions

Suppose $g(t)$, $0\leq t\leq T$, is a complete Ricci flow on a noncompact $n$-manifold with $|\Rm (g(t))|\leq k_0$. For every $O\in M$ there is a smooth $h:M o \mathbb R$ and $C=C(n,k_0,T)>0$ such that \[ C^{-1}(d_{g(t)}(O,x)+1)\leq h(x)\leq C(d_{g(t)}(O,x)+1), \] \[ | abla h|_{g(t)}\leq C,\qquad \Hess _{g(t)}h\leq Cg(t) \] on $M imes [0,T]$.

Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:bounded-curvature-distance-like-function Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0170, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0171 Take the function supplied by Lemma 4 for $g(0)$. Bounded Ricci curvature makes $g(t)$ and $g(0)$ uniformly equivalent, giving the distance and gradient bounds. Moreover

\[ \partial _t(\Hess _{g(t)}h)_{ij} =( abla _iR^k{}_j+ abla _jR^k{}_i- abla ^kR_{ij}) abla _kh. \]

Shi’s derivative estimate gives $| abla \Ric |\leq C t^{-1/2}$, while the gradient is uniformly bounded. Integrating this inequality from $0$ to $t$ and using uniform equivalence of the metrics yields the Hessian bound.

□
